iggy: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game sprite atlas. Input image is the official iggy character identity reference. Create ONE SQUARE EXACT 4 by 4 sprite sheet, 16 distinct poses of this SAME character, magenta hot pink fuzzy heart with perfectly round black sunglasses. Dramatically deform its soft body into these silhouettes, row major: original silhouette; tall narrow stretch; wide flat pancake; chunky chevron; crescent; upside-down U arch open at bottom; L shape; S shape; thick rounded five-lobe star; open comma; pear; horizontal connected dumbbell; banana; T shape; tapered rounded heart; zigzag. Not just rotation or facial changes: every silhouette must visibly differ. Keep aspect ratios under 2.5:1. IMPORTANT LAYOUT: image divided into 16 equal square cells. Center sprite at center of each cell (12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% in each axis). The ENTIRE sprite including accessories fits within central 60% of its cell, leaving 20% EMPTY transparent margin on all four sides of EVERY cell. Do not crop or touch neighboring sprites. No detached parts, no human hands or feet, no new facial features. No numbers, words, labels, grid lines, floor, shadows, background or props. True transparent alpha background.
